strings.gate-content: A note reads: “夜が来る前に、灯りをつけて。” The bridge is barely visible through the rain.
strings.open-gate-label: Raise the lantern and open the gate
strings.bridge-content: The lantern reveals three slick stones. Across the river, one warm window answers.
strings.ending-content: You reach the lantern house before nightfall. The crossing is complete.
